notes.notes:
[previewyoutube=https://www.youtube.com/watch?pt0-C625sEE;full][/previewyoutube]

Hello peeps!

Not only a newly designed village, this update also comes with other enhanced gameplay system such as the [b]animal system[/b], [b]daily life interaction[/b] and [b]minor control and bug fixes[/b]. More updates are on the way! Stay tuned!

Psstt! The Myriade Kingdom wants to rearrange its city too!
Now now, have a bright day!

- The NinjaVault Team

notes.title: Bug Fixes and Small Updates for v1.0.2
notes.notes:
We've got some feedback about the game controls that are confusing and not convenient. We hear you, so here we are with the fixes and updates mostly focusing on the game controls and some of the display problem. Below is the list of this update:

1. Basic movement is now using [b]WASD[/b] instead of the arrow keys.
2. You can now enable [b]Mouse Control[/b] for character movement in the Settings menu. By enabling this option, you can move the character by clicking on the ground instead of using WASD.
3. Pressing 'A' or 'D' will immediately moving the character to the left or right instead of just rotating.
4. There's a control guide option on the top right screen (the '?' button).
5. Basic Attack (Punch) is now using '0' instead of 'A'

Have a nice day!
The Ninja Vault Team

notes.title: Minor Bug Fixes for v1.0.1
notes.notes:
Some players may have found minor bugs in the game. Worry not, Parachronism is just updated to version 1.0.1 to fix minor bugs and here's the list:

[olist]
[*] Use 'Esc' to close all kind of menu screens
[*] Hotkey bugs that may interfere with the gameplay (b, q, r, c)
[*] Hotkeys updated to open Inventory (CTRL + B), Quest Logs (CTRL + Q), Relationship (CTRL + R), Character Info (CTRL + C)
[*] All food now show status value changes in the tooltips
[*] Save Screen that couldn't be closed once it's opened without actually saving now can be closed by pressing 'Esc'
[/olist]

Feel free to report any bugs that you find in the game so we can fix it for you!

Psst... A wiki is on the way!

Sincerely,
The Ninja Vault Team
